question: Should OpenClaw add a public `agents.setDefault` Gateway/protocol/SDK/Admin HTTP RPC, or keep default-agent writes on the existing config-write surfaces?
rationale: The request adds a new public operator API surface for persisted default-agent state, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Review the linked RPC PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92957 as the concrete API proposal.

options.title: Keep config writes as the API
options.body: Decline the new RPC surface and close the issue plus linked PR if maintainers want clients to keep using config write methods.

options.title: Ask for a narrower surface
options.body: Request a reduced API shape, such as Gateway-only without SDK/Admin HTTP exposure, if the full proposed surface is too broad.

recommendation.title: Review the linked RPC PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92957 as the concrete API proposal.
